pages.text: Harbor failed-delivery queue handbook. A failed delivery is retried at most four times. After the fourth failure, it moves to the sealed review queue. Nia Bose owns the failed-delivery queue.
The operations team reviews sealed queue entries within six business hours. This handbook does not state a subscription price.
A Harbor access approval remains valid for twelve minutes and can be consumed once. A new approval is required for another action. An approved export may be at most 18 MB.
Approvals are limited to the named destination. This policy does not state a monthly service price.
Harbor support records are kept for 21 days in APAC and 45 days in EMEA. The region of the record determines which period applies.
